CASH ROUNDING MEASURED 2026-10-12: floor-cent. This board was refused on 1,636 of the 1,882 polls that listed it between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-12, on rows failing cash - basis = futures by a fraction of a cent. Those refusals printed 267 distinct rows, and their residuals (quoted futures minus cash-plus-basis) were +0.25c x85, +0.5c x90 and +0.75c x92, never a negative one. The rows that published were exact. So the board posts cash TRUNCATED to the cent off a quarter-cent futures grid: 482.75c - 65c = 417.75c prints as 4.17, where rounding would print 4.18. floor-cent admits [0, 1) and explains every row; round-cent and round-cent-either are ruled out by the +0.5c and +0.75c rows. The rows are pinned in test/fixtures/wheatongrain-refusals-2026-10.json and checked by test/reader-repairs-2026-10-12.test.mjs.
